interpretation: First independent per-band baseline. Not an improvement claim or a replacement for the current display. All original promotion gates remain open.

coordinates.note: Rays use the existing ideal projected model grid. Reference centers use original WRF coordinates. These small existing differences are reported; no image registration or score-fitted shift applied.

12.earth_mask_definition: Strict clear = official ACM 0 and per-band validity/DQF; land/ocean = original model LANDMASK; both clear additionally requires the unchanged T3 vertical condensate mask 0. Native projected-grid rays may still cross adjacent clouds; this is not a cloud-free atmospheric counterfactual.
